svg.title: First launch and new-vault setup
svg.desc: Startup resolves a missing, complete or partial storage pair. New-vault setup is available only with no existing files, and requires a confirmed Master Password, a verified Authenticator code and explicit acknowledgement that a generated Recovery Key was saved. Core generates a DEK and verifies a staged v4 pair before persistence and a new unlocked login.

g.text: Read arrows in order. SECRET = plaintext; KEY = encryption key; cylinders = stored data.
